adenovirus induces eIF- 4E dephophorylation by a mechanism which is distinct from that used by other viruses, and that the adenoviral signal is linked to late viral gene expression.

The main takeaway from our work is that

adenovirus inhibitory activity on eIF-4e phosphorylation and cell protein synthesis is not due to the action of early adenovirus genes, but rather is a late event, linked to the activation of the viral transcriptional program.
adenovirus induces a late signal that inhibits eIF-4e phosphorylation and blocks host cell translation.
adenovirus inhibitions of cell protein synthesis are caused by the virus and are not simply a consequence of the inhibition of cell DNA synthesis.
